# Tidings

> Self-hosted personal finance dashboard. Email-first ingestion (no Plaid, no
> bank credentials). Your data lives on your disk.

- Repo: https://github.com/tvhahn/tidings
- Install: https://github.com/tvhahn/tidings/blob/main/INSTALL.md
- API surface: `/api/v1/*`, OpenAPI at `/openapi.json`, bearer auth optional
  (RFC-6750)
- Agent access guide:
  https://github.com/tvhahn/tidings/blob/main/docs/guides/agent-access.md
- License: MIT

## For agents

This app exposes a JSON HTTP API at `/api/v1/*` with optional bearer auth.
Read `INSTALL.md` for the agent-driven install path. Read
`docs/guides/agent-access.md` for the token issuance + scopes + curl/n8n
walkthrough. The OpenAPI schema at `/openapi.json` is committed to the
repo and drift-gated in CI, so it's safe to consume directly.

Try the API before installing — the demo journal is served read-only at
`https://gettidings.com/demo/api/v1` (fictional demo data, no auth). Its
OpenAPI schema is at `https://gettidings.com/demo/api/openapi.json`.
